description: Na₄Ti₇O₁₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eleven TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-63°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.18 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with ten TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.29 Å. There are four inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with five TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.23 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (1.97 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six TiO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (1.99 Å) and two longer (2.03 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the fourth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six TiO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (1.99 Å) and four longer (2.00 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ti atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaTi₃ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ti atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaTi₃ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaTi₃ tetrahedra.
